about_the_game:
The Last Partenopean is a narrative graphic adventure set in an alternate, decaying version of Naples.

Play as Walter and Anna, a father and daughter living on the fringes of society, whose paths intertwine as a mysterious virus drags the city to the brink of collapse.
Soon, Walter and Anna will find themselves gathering clues and interrogating eccentric Neapolitan characters and ruthless criminals within a city like no other.
To uncover the culprits, you’ll need to analyze every detail and distinguish the truth hidden behind the mask.

Discover a world where every word, gesture, and intuition can change everything. The fate of Naples lies in your hands.

Key Features:

  • A graphic adventure set in an alternate Naples, between reality and dystopia

  • Two playable protagonists with intertwining stories

  • Explorable environments rich in detail and mystery

  • Complex dialogue system with multiple choices and real consequences

  • Protagonist’s dialogue in Neapolitan

  • Collect and connect clues to form different deductions

  • Possibility to identify — or accuse — the wrong culprit

  • 2D Pixel Art visuals and indie soundtrack enhancing the game’s atmosphere

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains some mature content, such as characters covered in blood (for example zombies or the protagonist when attacked by enemies) and situations where some characters smoke or consume alcohol. Some enemies may also shoot or use knives against the protagonist. These elements are always tied to the narrative and are included solely to enhance the story and atmosphere, without any gratuitous intent. These behaviors are not endorsed by the development team.
